verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a GPU accelerator: physical hardware plus the ROCm software stack. Choosing a storage region or data residency is a property of hosted services, not something a chip or its runtime can offer, because data location is set by wherever the operator installs the hardware. The 'Instinct on Azure' guide only shows the GPU is available on a host cloud platform. That is a host-platform capability, so it does not make this axis apply to the product.
